description: Duties and taxes on one import, as of the tariff's version date: the third-country (MFN) duty or, with proof_of_origin, the lowest preferential duty under a trade agreement; extra duties in force for the origin (anti-dumping, countervailing, safeguard, US Section 301); excise (UK); import VAT (UK, or the EU member state's standard rate); US entry fees; and the landed cost. Destinations: gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). Each line has its measure, legal instrument and source. A duty that cannot be computed (a specific duty without quantity, an exporter-specific anti-dumping duty without additional_code) is shown as not computed and totals.complete is false with the reasons. Use get_tariff to find the 10-digit code. The figures are an estimate, not a customs ruling: TARIC is not legally binding, and the customs authority makes the final determination.

additional_code.description: Additional codes declared with the commodity code (up to 4): the exporter's code for exporter-specific anti-dumping or countervailing duties (e.g. 8A95).

customs_value.description: Customs value in the tariff's currency: CIF (price plus transport and insurance to the border) in GBP for the UK and EUR for the EU; the transaction value in USD for the US; INR for India.

destination.description: Importing country (required, or give importer): gb (the UK), eu or an EU member state (de, fr, it, es, nl…; its import VAT applies), us (the United States) or in (India). Names work too ("United Kingdom", "Germany").

documents.description: Document (certificate) codes declared with the goods (up to 10), e.g. D008 for the invoice that gives an EU exporter its own anti-dumping rate.

excise_code.description: UK excise additional code where several apply (e.g. X311).

hs_code.description: The 10-digit commodity code of the importing tariff (a shorter prefix works when it matches one line only), e.g. "0901210000"; dots and spaces are ignored.

origin.description: Country of origin of the goods (ISO code or name), e.g. "cn", "India".

proof_of_origin.description: true when the goods have a valid proof of origin for a preference: the lowest preferential duty is used instead of MFN. Default false.

quantity.description: Quantity in unit, for specific duties and excise (give unit too).

transport.description: US only: how the goods arrive; vessel adds the harbor maintenance fee.

unit.description: Unit of quantity: kg, g, tonne, 100 kg, l, hl, items, 1000 items, pairs, m, m2, m3, or the tariff's own unit (e.g. "% vol/hl").

vat_code.description: UK VAT additional code for another VAT rate (e.g. VATZ zero rate, VATR reduced rate).
